session_note: The 34th Alaska Legislature (2025-2026) held a First Regular Session (Jan 21-May 20, 2025) and a Second Regular Session (Jan 20-May 20, 2026), with bills carrying over automatically between the two without refiling; per akleg.gov the governor then called a 2nd Special Session (May 21-Jun 19, 2026), a 3rd Special Session (Jun 20-Jul 16, 2026), and a 4th Special Session beginning Jul 27, 2026 that remains open (no adjournment date posted) as of the 2026-07-31 research date, so the 34th Legislature has not sine die adjourned and no packet bill can be treated as dead by adjournment.

decisions.notes: No change from the packet's captured status. The bill carried over automatically from the 2025 First Regular Session into the 2026 Second Regular Session and subsequent special sessions per Alaska practice, but has received no committee action past the 2025-04-11 referral to House Finance. Because the 34th Legislature has not adjourned sine die (it is in an open 4th special session as of 2026-07-31), the bill is stalled but not formally dead; categorized in_committee rather than failed_died. Not enacted.
